Web Traffic Ads Optimization Goals

check.
Clicks - optimize for as many clicks (volume) to a URL destination of your choice, ensuring the most efficient cost per click possible
check.
Landing Page Views - optimize for as many views for a specific landing page and time on that landing page
check.
Engaged Sessions - optimize for users spending 10+ seconds on the landing page OR continue to visit a 2nd page from the destination
